_notes.derived: rating, verdict, pros, cons, rank_label, highlights and review_url are computed from data already in this file - the score breakdown, the tagline and the article slugs below. Nothing in them is invented.
_notes.seeded: Every deal also carries a "_seeded" list naming the fields filled with placeholders standing in for facts only you have. The importer writes that list to post meta, the Deals list shows a "To verify" column, and the deal editor shows a warning until you clear it. Check each against the vendor page before publishing.

still_empty.price, old_price: Left as found. Two deals carry a _needs_attention note saying the price is genuinely absent from the vendor page - inventing one would publish a false claim about a named company.
still_empty.image_id: Needs a media library that only exists on the destination site. Set the logo per deal, or the card falls back to the brand initials.
